explanation: erdosproblems.com/554: Day and Johnson proved that for fixed n, R_k(C_{2n+1}) ≥ 2n(2 + c_n)^{k−1} for all large k, for some c_n > 0. The Lean statement gives, for each n ≥ 1, c > 0 with 2n(2+c)^{k−1} < R_k(C_{2n+1}) eventually in k; the strict inequality (as in the docstring and DaJo17) can be obtained from the non-strict version by slightly decreasing c. Faithful.
